arguments.sql:
WITH quota_counts AS (
    SELECT BusinessEntityID, strftime('%Y', QuotaDate) AS quota_year, COUNT(*) AS records
    FROM main.SalesPersonQuotaHistory
    GROUP BY BusinessEntityID, strftime('%Y', QuotaDate)
)
SELECT
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM quota_counts WHERE records > 1) AS salesperson_years_with_multiple_quota_records,
    (SELECT MAX(records) FROM quota_counts) AS maximum_records_per_salesperson_year,
    COUNT(*) AS orders_with_salesperson,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN h.subtotal <> h.totaldue THEN 1 END) AS orders_with_different_subtotal_and_totaldue
FROM main.salesorderheader AS h
JOIN main.salesperson AS s ON s.businessentityid = h.salespersonid
